title: Avinya Voluntary Blood Donation Drive
short_description: Voluntary blood donation camp supporting emergency healthcare.
description: Avinya Care Foundation organized a voluntary blood donation drive in partnership with local blood banks to ensure timely supply for emergency surgeries and critical patients.
alt_text: Voluntary donor donating blood at Avinya Care medical camp

title: Community Cancer Awareness & Prevention Session
short_description: Educational session on early cancer screening and preventive care.
description: Healthcare specialists conducted an interactive awareness seminar on early symptom recognition, lifestyle choices, and free diagnostic screening programs for community members.
alt_text: Avinya Care healthcare professional addressing community members on cancer awareness

title: Comprehensive Community Health & Screening Camp
short_description: Free diagnostic checkups and doctor consultations for families.
description: Our health camp offered blood pressure tests, diabetes screening, and general physician consultations to over 400 individuals in underprivileged neighborhoods.
alt_text: Doctor conducting general health checkup at Avinya Care camp

title: Rural Healthcare Outreach & Medical Relief Drive
short_description: Delivering healthcare and preventive kits to remote villages.
description: Avinya Care Foundation's mobile medical unit reached rural hamlets to distribute essential healthcare supplies, hygiene kits, and medical care.
alt_text: Community outreach team distributing medical kits

title: Donor Care & Post-Donation Recovery Support
short_description: Medical checks and post-donation donor wellness care.
description: Medical staff and volunteers ensuring safe donor recovery with proper rest, fluids, and post-donation monitoring during blood drives.
alt_text: Medical staff providing post-donation care to voluntary donor

title: Interactive Health & Hygiene Educational Workshop
short_description: Educational workshop on youth hygiene and preventive wellness.
description: Interactive sessions empowering students and youth with personal hygiene practices, hand washing protocols, and healthy living habits.
alt_text: Avinya educator presenting hygiene workshop to youth

title: Women Financial Literacy & Empowerment Drive
short_description: Empowering women with micro-savings and financial tools.
description: Workshops teaching women micro-savings strategies, household budgeting, and accessing government welfare and insurance schemes.

title: Nutritional Aid & Food Security Distribution Drive
short_description: Distributing healthy meal packages to underprivileged families.
description: Distributing essential food grain kits and nutritious meals to vulnerable families, elderly citizens, and children.
alt_text: Volunteers handing food kits to community families

title: Volunteer Hydration & Donor Recovery Assistance
short_description: Providing post-donation hydration and donor support.
description: Avinya volunteers providing hydration and donor care post-blood donation to ensure smooth recovery and donor satisfaction.
alt_text: Avinya volunteer handing hydration bottle to donor

title: Volunteer Registration & Health Campaign Helpdesk
short_description: Volunteers assisting patient registration and vitals checking.
description: Dedicated volunteers managing registration desks, vitals measurement, and guidance for patients visiting health camps.
alt_text: Volunteers at campaign registration desk assisting visitors
